Co-op uses the game files of SpongeBob Movie Port where they are. Choose the folder that holds boot.HIP and font.HIP (the one SpongeBob Movie Port uses). This needs All files access.\n\nIf SpongeBob Movie Port copied the files into itself, co-op cannot read that copy: choose the folder the files came from.

Co-op uses the saves and game files of the SpongeBob Movie Port app. Install or update it (version 0.9, build 14 or newer), open it once, then open co-op again.\n\nYou can also play co-op without saving: nothing is kept when it closes.

The SpongeBob Movie Port app on this phone was not built with the same key as TSSM co-op, so co-op cannot use its saves. Install both from the same place.\n\nYou can also play co-op without saving: nothing is kept when it closes.

Android did not give TSSM co-op the permission to use the saves of SpongeBob Movie Port, which should not happen. Install both apps again from the same place, then open co-op.\n\nYou can also play co-op without saving: nothing is kept when it closes.
